import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                label=bmi, alpha=0.6, s=50, c=colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6'))
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sleep_disorder_order = ['None', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Insomnia']
existing_disorders = [d for d in sleep_disorder_order if d in df['Sleep Disorder Filled'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Sleep Disorder Filled', y='Stress Level', ax=ax2, 
            order=existing_disorders, palette='Set2')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 3: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax3.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=plt.cm.viridis(
    [i/len(occupation_sleep) for i in range(len(occupation_sleep))]))
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')
for i, v in enumerate(occupation_sleep.values):
    ax3.text(v + 0.05, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Physical Activity vs Daily Steps colored by Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax4.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'], 
                label=gender, alpha=0.6, s=50, 
                c='#3498db' if gender == 'Male' else '#e91e63')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Gender')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
